papers.title_en: Active Reachability Learning for Humanoid Recoverability Monitoring
papers.authors: Zeyuan Feng, Baljeet Singh, Sarthak Ranjeet Kaingade, Somil Bansal, Bryan Trinh
papers.evidence: 基于价值学习与可达-规避探索的人形机器人可恢复性监测
papers.tldr: 人形机器人部署任务策略需要运行时监控器及时预判不可恢复跌倒并触发回退。本文将监控器学习建模为回退策略的随机有限时域可恢复包络，并提出值学习与主动探索交替的统一框架，将数据探索转为 reach-avoid 问题，结合 TD 与蒙特卡洛目标估计不确定性并抑制 OOD 乐观幻觉。在随机基准与 29 自由度 Unitree G1 上，方法显著提升覆盖率和准确率，并零样本迁移到真实硬件。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying humanoid task policies requires reliable runtime monitors that anticipate unrecoverable falls in time to trigger a fallback. We formulate this task as learning the stochastic, finite-horizon recoverability envelope of a given fallback policy. Synthesizing this monitor is challenging: existing methods assume training data naturally covers the recoverability envelope, yet acquiring such data remains a major bottleneck for contact-rich systems. Consequently, they recover only a fraction of the true envelope, leaving them prone to optimistic hallucinations for out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. We resolve this via a unified framework that iterates between value learning and active exploration. Data exploration is reframed as a reach-avoid problem, where an uncertainty-guided explorer systematically uncovers unseen states while avoiding confidently unrecoverable regions. This loop is further supported by a combined Temporal Difference and Monte Carlo objective for accurate in-distribution value prediction and reliable uncertainty estimation. By explicitly treating the remaining high-uncertainty regions as unrecoverable, the monitor mitigates optimistic OOD hallucinations. Evaluated on stochastic benchmarks and a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid, our approach drastically improves monitor coverage and accuracy and successfully transfers zero-shot to real-world hardware.

papers.title_en: Graph-Convolutional Reinforcement Learning for Finite-Time Stabilization of a Chaotic Chua Circuit via Unified Flexible Terminal Sliding-Mode Control
papers.authors: Hooman Fatoorehchi, Majid Roohi, Rasmus Kold, Matthias Ehrhardt, Andreas Basse-O'Connor, Sebastian Nis Bay Villadsen, Philip L. Fosbøl
papers.evidence: 将滑模控制与强化学习结合实现稳定控制
papers.tldr: 针对物理Chua电路混沌振荡的有限时间镇定问题，论文建立含电容电压、电感电流和元件参数的电路模型，提出统一柔性终端滑模控制器，并用图卷积强化学习优化控制参数。数值实验显示状态与滑模变量有限时间收敛且满足输入饱和；相比参考方法，IAE、ISE、ITAE、ITSE分别降低56.27%、56.40%、61.69%、64.70%。该工作将图结构强化学习与滑模理论结合，在保持鲁棒性和解析结构的同时减少人工调参。
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a graph convolutional reinforcement learning framework for the finite-time stabilization of chaotic dynamics in a physical Chua circuit. The circuit is modeled directly in terms of capacitor voltages, inductor current, and physical component parameters. This preserves the connection between the mathematical model and the underlying electrical system. A unified, flexible terminal sliding-mode controller is developed to achieve stabilization within a finite time in the presence of uncertainties in the lumped model, external disturbances, and bounded control inputs. The controller incorporates state-dependent nonlinear exponents to provide flexible convergence characteristics while avoiding singular terms near equilibrium. To minimize dependence on manual controller tuning, the admissible controller parameters are optimized using an actor-critic reinforcement learning scheme with a graph convolutional network that leverages the circuit dynamics' coupling structure. The learned parameters are constrained to the ranges required by the theoretical stability conditions. Numerical experiments demonstrate the rapid suppression of chaotic oscillations and the finite-time convergence of the state and sliding variables while respecting the prescribed input-saturation limits. Compared to a reference control method, the proposed approach reduces the IAE, ISE, ITAE, and ITSE by 56.27\,\%, 56.40\,\%, 61.69\,\%, and 64.70\,\%, respectively. These results suggest that graph-based reinforcement learning can effectively tune parameters while retaining the robustness and analytical structure of the underlying sliding-mode controller.

papers.title_en: Tokens of Motion: Primitive Motion Learning for Human-Humanoid Skill Transfer
papers.authors: Hanwen Ren, Meng Zheng, Wenzhe Cui, Benjamin Planche, Zhongpai Gao, Anwesa Choudhuri, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu
papers.evidence: 面向人-人形机器人技能迁移的基元运动学习
papers.tldr: VLA模型依赖仅成功样本的行为克隆，缺乏纠错训练信号，微小执行误差会迅速累积为不可恢复的分布外失败。为此，AFIL将失败轨迹作为自适应负引导，共享视觉语言主干联合训练成功与失败双动作生成器，并在采样时依据分布距离引导动作远离失败区域。域内域外短长时操作实验显示，其成功率和鲁棒性稳定优于现有VLA基线，证明失败感知学习高效且通用。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.

papers.title_en: A switching proximal gradient method for constrained difference-of-convex optimization problems
papers.authors: Yuncheng Liu, Chuangliang Zhang, Bo Yang
papers.evidence: 面向约束凸复合优化的近端梯度求解方法
papers.tldr: 针对含多个复合不等式约束的DC优化问题，提出主化引导的切换近端梯度法MGSPG。外层用二次主化与线性化构造强凸复合代理问题，内层SPG在近可行时更新目标、否则更新最违反约束，无需联合投影或乘子计算。理论上给出内层O(τ^-1)复杂度，并在有界水平集与一致Slater条件下以O(ε^-2)外层迭代求得ε-KKT点，组件近端更新O(ε^-4)。SCAD与分组约束回归实验显示其可行且高效。
papers.abstract_en: We study difference-of-convex optimization problems with several composite inequality constraints and develop a majorization-guided switching proximal gradient (MGSPG) method. Specifically, at each feasible outer point, quadratic majorization and linearization yield a strongly convex composite surrogate problem. To solve this surrogate approximately, we employ a switching proximal gradient (SPG) method, which takes a proximal gradient step for the objective when the current point is nearly feasible and for a most violated constraint otherwise. This construction requires neither projection onto the joint surrogate feasible set nor multiplier computation. By establishing a common invariant ball and using an increasing weight argument, we obtain an \(O(τ^{-1})\) inner complexity bound for SPG. Building on this bound, we show that, under boundedness of the feasible level set and a uniform Slater condition for the surrogates, MGSPG finds an \(\varepsilon\)-KKT point in \(O(\varepsilon^{-2})\) outer iterations and \(O(\varepsilon^{-4})\) selected component proximal gradient updates. Numerical experiments on SCAD-constrained and groupwise-constrained regression problems demonstrate the viability and computational efficiency of our method compared with existing optimization algorithms.
